title: Agent registration audit recorded but entity not created or retrievable
description: Registration appears to succeed (audit event is recorded) but the agent entity is not actually created in the system or cannot be retrieved via the API, returning 404 on subsequent lookups.
reproduction_steps: Register a new agent via the registration endpoint or CLI
Verify audit log shows registration event
Attempt to retrieve agent details via GET /agents/{agent_id}
Observe 404 response despite successful registration audit
expected_behavior: After successful registration with audit event recorded, the agent entity should be created and retrievable via GET /agents/{agent_id}.
actual_behavior: Registration audit event is recorded but GET /agents/{agent_id} returns 404, indicating the agent entity was not persisted or is not accessible.
evidence: Registration audit event recorded but agent entity not created or retrievable via API (404 on /agents/:agent_id)

title: Proxied requests reach test API but execution records not created in platform
description: The broker successfully proxies requests to the test API (66 GET requests received), but the platform fails to create execution records for these requests, suggesting logging or audit trail failure.
reproduction_steps: Configure agent with toolkit access to test API
Make proxied GET requests through the Jentic broker to /get endpoint
Verify requests reach the test API successfully
Observe no execution records created despite successful proxying
expected_behavior: All proxied requests through the broker should generate execution records in the platform for audit and monitoring purposes.
actual_behavior: Test API received 66 GET /get requests successfully, but no execution records were created in the platform database or API.
evidence: Test API received 66 GET /get requests but no execution records created in platform; requests bypassed broker or logging failed
